items.label: 3-Piece Garden Furniture Suite
items.value: This set features a square side table and two roomy armchairs, crafted with hand-woven PE rattan. Designed to blend practicality with style, it creates a comfortable and inviting corner in your outdoor space for unwinding or enjoying a good conversation

items.label: Firm Construction
items.value: This 3pccs garden set is built for years to come, using weather-resistant PE rattan and robust powder-coated metal frames. Both the table and chairs are further strengthened with PE rattan panels beneath the seat and tabletop by connecting the legs into a firm integration

items.label: Rustic PE Rattan
items.value: Made from durable, weather-resistant polyethylene rattan, this garden suite shows off a natural, rustic look with carefully hand-woven details, bringing subtle charm and thoughtful design to your outdoor space

items.label: Aesthetic Appeal
items.value: This wicker furniture set brings a touch of timeless charm to your outdoor space, blending effortlessly with any style. Its natural design adds warmth and elegance, creating a cozy, welcoming atmosphere where you can truly relax and enjoy the moment

items.label: Soft Cushions for Lasting Comfort
items.value: The wide seats feature 2.4″ thick high-density foam cushions that stay soft and resist deformation over time, providing a cozy, supportive seating experience. Removable, water-resistant covers with zippers make cleaning effortless

items.label: Assembly Instructions Description
items.value: Assembly required. Easy and simple to follow with provided instructions and mountings. Electronic version also available.

items.label: Material
items.value: Steel, PE Rattan, Foam, Polyester, Tempered Glass
